other_conditions: The applicant must be a dairy farmer.
The applicant must have made extraordinary contributions in dairy farming by achieving the highest milk production in the State of Goa.
The applicant must be a member of a Dairy Co‑operative Society, Bachat Gat or Self Help Group registered with the concerned Department.
The applicant must register his dairy farm with the Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services through the respective Area Officers of Veterinary Dispensary/Hospital.
The applicant must be a bonafide resident of Goa for at least the preceding five years and own a cattle shed with milch animals in Goa.

The applicant must produce and pour a minimum of 100,000 litres of milk in the preceding year (April to March) with an average of at least 250 litres per day to the Dairy Co‑operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group.
benefits_summary: The award includes a Certificate of Appreciation, a memento and a cash prize of ₹1,00,000.
